notes.title: Good news everyone
notes.notes: Hi. We decided to make our Reality’s Reverse Side novel free for you. We got many emails from people who asked for a free key and thought that we could provide our game to everyone at once. It’ll become free in a week. If you want to support the developer you can still buy it during this week. If you bought the game earlier and think it’s unfair, contact us and we’ll provide you a key for another game from CupCakeTime Team
